$comment: DERIVED, not verbatim. Written by this library from the prose of the W3C Recommendation Verifiable Credential Data Integrity 1.0 (REC-vc-data-integrity-20250515), which prints no JSON Schema, CDDL or ABNF of its own (README.md gives the search). Source .cache/w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0.bin, sha256 ba5c4baf13fe3bab3ebd95ab6650d6fe83720e254b383bb444b4fbbae7bcf4fe; quotations are cut from its rendering .cache/w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0.txt, sha256 2b7725f80e138ef943eff25050eee6a62f8887762ca9e1e03867c55ea5647beb, and cite its line numbers (L). LEVELS: the root and every anchor not ending in -should state MUST and MUST NOT rules, so a failure there is non-conformance; an anchor ending in -should adds SHOULD statements and includes the root by reference, so a failure there is a warning. MAY statements are never constraints: a leniency a MAY grants has its own anchor, named for the leniency. A constraint marked INFERRED is a reading this library made, not a statement of the source; one marked OUTSIDE-SOURCE comes from a document the source names and is not this source's. Rule ids (P-nn, S-nn, V-nn, E-nn, O-nn, M-nn) are those of rules.derived.yaml. INSTANCE: the options map passed to createProof, Add Proof (4.2) and Add Proof Set/Chain (4.3). The source defines no options vocabulary of its own: a cryptosuite defines its options. It names three items: domain and challenge (Add Proof steps 3 and 4) and previousProof (Add Proof Set/Chain steps 4 and 5). ROOT = those three, each optional; the source says “non-null domain item” (L552) and “non-null challenge item” (L553) so null is allowed for domain and challenge. All other items are allowed.

domain.$comment: O-10 w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0#R-0184: “If options has a non-null domain item, it MUST be equal to proof.domain or an error MUST be raised” (L552) The type is INFERRED from proof.domain.

challenge.$comment: O-11 w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0#R-0186: “If options has a non-null challenge item, it MUST be equal to proof.challenge or an error MUST be raised” (L553)

previousProof.$comment: O-12 (a string or an array: the clauses carry no keyword) “If options has a previousProof item that is a string” (L564) and “If options has a previousProof item that is an array” (L565); the MUST of each step, for a previousProof that matches no proof, is w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0#R-0199 and w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0#R-0202.
